scope: Advisory bottom-fish mode of the swing desk. Development data: everything up to 2026-10-06 incl. PNJ 2026 and the BF-doc descriptive study. A green result does not approve trading or larger size.
unit: episode = ticker x fall episode (episode_start); clustered by market episode (VNINDEX -5%/5 sessions)

arms.bf_baseline: VN30 tickers with price-only fall type MARKET (idx_ret_5d <= -5% or PANIC_BEAR with breadth < 40%, idio_ret_10d > -8%), stab_state STAB2 and BF-G3/G4/G7 PASS; excluded if a bf-news record for the session says fact_negative; flagged price_only_classification when no bf-news record exists; P1 standard plan
arms.bf_knife: same MARKET-type tickers/episodes with a floor close in the episode; hypothetical entry at the open after the first floor close of the episode (counterfactual; that entry can precede the freeze); same P1 exits
arms.bf_random: 3 random VN30 tickers with ret_10d <= -10%, seeded by the target session date; P1 plan
arms.bf_desk: optional, <= 1 analyst bottom-fish idea per session, type a only (freeze --source bf_desk)
arms.user_bf: every check --mode bottomfish (checks.jsonl, mode=bottomfish) and every journal BUY with reason=bottomfish

plan_P1.entry: limit close x 1.005 on the next session (no fill -> no_fill)
plan_P1.lock: no exit on the entry session and the next one (T+2.5)
plan_P1.invalidation: close < panic_low -> exit next open (closes from e+2)
plan_P1.catastrophe: close <= fill x 0.88 -> exit next open (closes from e+2)
plan_P1.exit_signal: close > SMA5 or close > EMA21 -> exit next open (closes from e+2)
plan_P1.floor_carry: an exit planned at the open of a session that closes <= -6.5% is deferred to the next open; count floor_lock_days
plan_P1.risk: 1% NAV on the effective loss 12 + 7 + 0.6 = 19.6% (user decision 2026-10-06)

hypotheses.BF-H1: bf_baseline mean net > 0 at 0.6% cost (positive net profit, not merely beating VNINDEX)
hypotheses.BF-H3: bf_baseline - bf_knife (cost/benefit of BF-G3/G4; may be negative)
hypotheses.BF-H4: user BF trades tagged BLOCK have lower mean net than PASS; descriptive until >= 30 per group
hypotheses.BF-H5: share of user BF checks/trades with BF-B1/B4/B5 violations declines across quarters

analysis: block bootstrap by market episode; report per episode and per year; cash-restart vs held attribution; monthly new BF episodes and zero-episode months (expected, not a failure); floor_lock_days and no-fill rate
decision: 'not proven' unless the CI > 0 at 0.6% cost in both halves and across >= 3 market episodes; any rule/profile change -> new protocol version
